The studio

A one-camera, one-vision approach — every wedding cut and colour-graded by the same hand that shot it.

Amey Reddy Films started with a single Sony FX3 and a conviction that Indian weddings deserve to be filmed with the same patience and restraint as narrative cinema — natural light, long lenses, and a willingness to wait for the real moment instead of staging one.

Every project moves through the same hands from first shot to final grade: on-location filming, sound design, and a DaVinci Resolve colour pass built to hold skin tones and gold jewellery without ever looking flat.
